sourceGuards.claim: NativeNoteOperation aliases NoteMutationOptions; SAVE keeps legacy string revision at arg4 and discriminates arg5 operation object versus Compound sourceStoreId string; authenticated native branch validates operation then commits journal and returns, without legacy fallthrough.

Native principal/workspace/action/fence required; nativeAction remains write. PREPARE_CREATE returns only canonical plan/context/fences/mutation, no journal/file mutation; explicit legacy null grants no native fallback.
Authenticated native descriptor projection returns store:null; metadata cannot activate MarkdownCommitStore.

Native services retain canonical queue requirement: commitMarkdown/applyMarkerMapping/legacy writeNative/legacy receipt paths refuse unavailable store; active native authority denies unauthenticated legacy source access.
One source-bound writer selected; immutable native identity/opened revision and projection binding checked; errors propagate directly without fallback to Markdown writer.
Native page saves queue+flush through nativeNotesSync; bound non-native documents keep Compound CAS writer, including same legacy operation replay on unknown outcome.
Identity/opened CAS guard preserves draft; only own queued operation after successful ACK advances revision; workspace/session fences and stop prevent stale progression.
Sender-owned managed-window custody, secure credential-backed outbox, renderer-loss cleanup, private canonical create enqueue, snapshot-only save enqueue, exact receipt validation before durable ACK.
Authenticated RPC observed receipt and live context generation required for ACK; canonical PREPARE_CREATE rechecked, then main enqueue completes before MUTATE and ACK.
Offline operation gets stable main-owned ID and returns only after outbox.enqueue completes; later retries reuse persisted operation.
Encrypted durable SQLite outbox uses WAL/synchronous FULL, commit-before-return enqueue, payload digest, atomic acknowledgement insertion/pending deletion, encrypted snapshots and receipts.
ACK matches exact queued issuer/subject/workspace/kind/entity/operation, sequence, next numeric revision, deletion and actual content hash.
Canonical journal verifies authorization, stable operation payload digest, returns same durable receipt on replay, refuses stale revision/foreign bytes and persists next numeric revision/receipt.
Actual positional-wire negative checks arg5 source-store string and shifted arg4 operation; both deny missing metadata, retain identity/revision/content and no .rox-docs legacy WAL.
